text: Put some toy animals up on a chair and say, ‘Oh no, the animals are stuck high up on the cliff! How will they escape?’
Put some toy animals up on a chair and say, ‘Oh no, the animals are stuck high up on the cliff! How will they escape?’

Together, use other figures and objects to act out the story of how the animals were rescued from the cliff.

Ideas:

  • Several other animals try different ways of rescuing, but they all fail until the last, brave animal comes along…
  • Have the animals discuss among themselves how they could work together to escape!


Tip:

To make it into more of a story, narrate what is happening while you’re moving the characters around. Speak like you are the words in the book, e.g. say, ‘Then the brave kitten started to climb the rocky side of the cliff!’ as you move a toy cat up the chair leg.

If your child wants to tell a completely different story, that’s ok – go with their ideas and see what happens!
